name: Railcraft High Pressure Boiler
notes: Railcraft high-pressure steam boiler (Railcraft 9.17.31, the version in GTNH 2.9.0-beta-3). Solid firebox at the base, high-pressure boiler tanks above it; the height grows with the number of tank layers (3x3 firebox, 2 to 4 tanks). Walls are modelled as Solid Steel Machine Casing; in game any non-boiler block works. Hatches are not modelled. Wiki: the boiler cannot wallshare any part of its structure and must be at least one block from another boiler. Only the 3-wide high-pressure boiler is included; low-pressure, 1x1 and 2x2 variants are not.
